faqs.q: Who is Crestora Properties and what makes your developments unique?
faqs.a: Crestora Properties is a premier real estate development company dedicated to creating benchmark plotted communities and luxury residences across Coimbatore and key growth corridors of the Kongu region. We differentiate ourselves through 100% DTCP and RERA compliance, clear legal titles, rapid patta transfers, and high-quality physical infrastructure like wide blacktop roads, underground utilities, and landscaped entrance gateways.

faqs.q: Are all Crestora Properties projects DTCP and RERA approved?
faqs.a: Yes. Every single plotted community and villa enclave developed by Crestora Properties undergoes rigorous legal due diligence and obtains mandatory DTCP (Directorate of Town and Country Planning) sanctions, alongside Tamil Nadu RERA registration. RERA registration numbers and approval orders are publicly disclosed on every project brochure and webpage.

faqs.q: Can NRI investors purchase plots or villas remotely?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Through our specialized 'Crestora for NRI' concierge, non-resident investors can complete the entire acquisition journey remotely. We provide 360-degree virtual walkthroughs, live drone footage, digital legal document verification, NRE/NRO bank assistance, and coordination for registered Power of Attorney (POA) if you cannot travel in person.

faqs.q: What is Crestora Build Companion and how does it assist landowners?
faqs.a: Crestora Build Companion is our end-to-end turnkey architectural and construction service. Once you purchase a plot from Crestora Properties, our expert team helps you with architectural blueprints, vastu verification, structural drawings, government plan sanctions, contractor selection, and construction supervision with weekly photo updates.

faqs.q: Which banks have pre-approved Crestora Properties developments for home & plot loans?
faqs.a: All our projects are pre-approved by India's leading institutional lenders, including State Bank of India (SBI), HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Axis Bank, Bank of Baroda, and LIC Housing Finance. We offer dedicated on-site loan desks to assist buyers with swift approvals at the most competitive interest rates.

faqs.q: What types of property categories are available at Crestora Properties?
faqs.a: We offer five prime property categories: (1) Plots (DTCP & RERA Gated Villa Plots), (2) Villas (Luxury Custom Villas), (3) Farmlands (Hillside Agro & Eco Farmhouses), (4) Commercial Lands (High-Visibility Highway Corridors), and (5) Gated Communities (Master-Planned Townships).

sections.heading: 1. The Infrastructure Catalyst: 10.1 km Elevated Expressway
paragraphs: The transformation of Western Coimbatore over the past half-decade has been anchored by massive state and national highway capital projects. Foremost among these is the state-of-the-art Avinashi Road Elevated Corridor—a 10.1 km six-lane elevated highway stretching from Uppilipalayam straight to Goldwins.

This engineering marvel removes bottleneck intersections across Hope College, Peelamedu, and Nava India, connecting the core downtown commercial district with the airport corridor and Neelambur bypass in under 12 uninterrupted minutes. For property buyers, accessibility is the primary determinant of land appreciation, and Neelambur sits right at the terminus of this high-speed artery.
sections.quote: Real estate investment returns are inherently married to arterial velocity. When commute times to international transport hubs drop below 15 minutes, plotted land values experience an exponential repricing curve.

sections.heading: 2. The Industrial & IT Convergence at Neelambur
paragraphs: Historically recognized as Coimbatore's premier textile engineering threshold, Neelambur has evolved into a diversified technological and medical corridor. Bordered by the Larsen & Toubro bypass and National Highway 544, it provides direct, seamless transit to Salem, Erode, Tirupur, and Kochi.

Moreover, Neelambur's immediate proximity to healthcare powerhouses like KMCH Speciality Hospitals, Royal Care, and world-class academic institutions (PSG Institute of Technology, Coimbatore Institute of Technology) creates sustained housing demand for senior consultants, professors, and tech founders.

sections.heading: 3. Land Price Appreciation & Rental Yield Trends

posts.title: DTCP vs RERA: What Every Land Investor in Tamil Nadu Must Know Before Buying
posts.subtitle: A comprehensive legal verification blueprint: decoding OSR gift deeds, layout approval numbers, panchayat traps, and RERA registration authenticity.
posts.excerpt: Don't fall for unauthorized layout traps. Learn the critical distinctions between DTCP layout approvals and TN RERA project registrations to safeguard your family's hard-earned life savings.

An unapproved layout masquerading as a 'panchayat approval' cannot be registered or financed by nationalized banks.
Inspect the Gift Deed for Open Space Reservation (OSR) handed over to the local body before buying.
Always demand the 30-year nil-encumbrance certificate (EC) from the Sub-Registrar Office.

3. Beware the 'Panchayat Approved' Misconception

5. Why Grade-A Bank Pre-Approval is Your Best Shield

sections.heading: 1. The Fundamental Distinction: DTCP vs TN RERA
paragraphs: One of the most frequent points of confusion among property buyers in Tamil Nadu is the difference between DTCP (Directorate of Town and Country Planning) approval and RERA (Real Estate Regulatory Authority) registration.

DTCP is the state statutory authority responsible for territorial master planning, zoning classifications, street widths (e.g., minimum 30 or 40-foot roads), and parks. In contrast, TN RERA is the consumer protection regulator that monitors developers' delivery timelines, escrow bank accounts, marketing claims, and title genuineness.
In simple terms: DTCP sanctions the physical layout, while RERA guarantees commercial, legal, and consumer accountability.
sections.quote: A legally sound plotted development must possess BOTH a valid DTCP layout sanction number AND an official TN RERA registration order.

sections.heading: 2. The OSR & Public Road Handover Gift Deed
paragraphs: Under Tamil Nadu Combined Development and Building Rules (TNCDBR), any plotted layout spanning more than 2,500 square meters must compulsorily allocate 10% of the land for Open Space Reservation (OSR), such as public parks and utilities.

Crucially, the developer must legally surrender both the internal road network and OSR plots to the local Panchayat or Municipal Corporation via a registered Gift Deed. Without this registered gift deed, the layout approval is legally incomplete and individual plot buyers may face building sanction denials in the future.

sections.heading: 3. Beware the 'Panchayat Approved' Misconception
paragraphs: Unscrupulous brokers frequently advertise plots as 'Panchayat Approved'. Legally speaking, village panchayats possess zero statutory power to sanction residential layout subdivisions without prior written concurrence from the DTCP Member Secretary.

Under Section 22-A of the Tamil Nadu Registration Act, sub-registrars are strictly prohibited from registering plots in unapproved subdivisions. Buyers caught in such layouts cannot obtain electricity connections, water pipelines, or bank construction mortgages.

sections.heading: 4. The Crestora 7-Point Legal Title Checklist
paragraphs: Before issuing any token advance, verify that the developer produces the following verifiable documentation:

1. DTCP Layout Approval Order with sealed master drawing.
2. TN RERA Registration Certificate with project QR code.
3. Registered Gift Deed for internal roads and OSR parks.
4. Parent Title Deeds establishing 30-year unbroken chain of ownership.
5. Sub-Registrar Encumbrance Certificate (EC) for 30 years.
6. Revenue Patta in the developer's legal name.
7. Field Measurement Book (FMB) sketch issued by the Taluk surveyor.

sections.heading: 5. Why Grade-A Bank Pre-Approval is Your Best Shield
paragraphs: When institutional lenders like State Bank of India, HDFC Bank, and ICICI Bank approve a project, their empanelled senior advocates independently examine title deeds and municipal records.
At Crestora Properties, all developments are 100% pre-approved by tier-1 banks, guaranteeing that your title is clear, marketable, and unencumbered.

sections.heading: 1. FEMA Regulations on NRI Land Purchases
paragraphs: Under the Reserve Bank of India's Foreign Exchange Management Act (FEMA) guidelines, Non-Resident Indians (NRIs) and Overseas Citizens of India (OCIs) are fully eligible to acquire residential and commercial properties in India without requiring special prior government permissions.

The only statutory restriction pertains to agricultural land, plantation properties, and farmhouses, which require specific heritage status or clearances. All Crestora residential villa plots are classified under residential conversion with DTCP sanctions, making them 100% compliant for NRI purchases.
sections.quote: Owning homeland real estate provides overseas Indians with dual benefits: a generational anchor for retirement and an asset yielding superior inflation-adjusted capital returns.

sections.heading: 2. Banking Protocols: NRE vs NRO Inward Remittances
paragraphs: All consideration money for the acquisition must be paid through normal banking channels by way of inward remittance from abroad, or out of balances held in your NRE (Non-Resident External) or NRO (Non-Resident Ordinary) account.

When you purchase via an NRE account, the sale proceeds upon future liquidation can be fully repatriated outside India up to two residential properties, subject to payment of applicable capital gains tax.

sections.heading: 3. Executing a Specific Power of Attorney (POA)
paragraphs: If you are unable to fly down to Coimbatore for the physical registration appointment at the Sub-Registrar's Office, you can execute a Specific Power of Attorney in favor of a trusted relative or legal counsel.

The process is simple: execute the draft on stamp paper or embassy document, sign it in front of the Consular Officer at your nearest Indian Embassy or High Commission, and have it dispatched to India for adjudication at the District Registrar Office within 90 days.

sections.heading: 4. Virtual Due Diligence & 360° Site Inspections

sections.heading: 5. Sub-Registrar Registration & Patta Delivery

Original registered deeds and government patta certificates are then securely dispatched via insured international courier (DHL/FedEx) directly to your overseas residence.
